summary: Aurora Cannabis responded on August 11, 2026 to an unsolicited take-over bid proposal from Curaleaf Holdings, announced via press release and filed on Form 6-K. Curaleaf offered US$4.00 per share (0.3463 Curaleaf shares plus US$0.75 cash) with a US$5.00 cap. Aurora's board will form a special committee to evaluate; no decision made. Aurora notes the cap is below recent trading prices. Shareholders advised to take no action. Watch for possible revised bid or competing offers.
